name: Ronald Campbell Macfie
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Ronald Campbell Macfie (1867–1931) was a Scottish poet and medical doctor. Lyra Celtica describes him as the author of Granite Dust and one of the most promising of the younger Celtic Scots.
The anthology prints one of his songs.

poems.title: Song
poems.author: Ronald Campbell Macfie
poems.text:
Alas, alas, eheu!
That the sky is only blue,
  To gather from the grass
The rain and dew!

Alas! that eyes are fair:
That tears may gather there
  Mist and the breath of sighs
From the marsh of care!

Alas, alas, eheu!
That we meet but to bid adieu:
  That the sands in Time’s ancient glass
Are so swift and few!

Alas, alas, eheu!
That the heart is only true
  To gather, where false feet pass,
The thorn and rue!
